landings.headline: Dubai Municipality Approvals for American Business Owners
landings.summary: How American owners obtain Dubai Municipality and related approvals: activity, premises and food-safety reviews alongside the trade licence.
landings.contentHtml:
Municipal approvals when the owner is in the United States

American founders and remote teams use Dubai as a base for clients in the Middle East, South Asia and Africa, and some move operations to work in a time zone that overlaps with Asia and Europe. Because the dirham is pegged to the dollar, contracts and budgets in dollars are easy to plan. Municipal rules are the same for every nationality, so this page focuses on how an owner in the United States gets the approvals done: authority for someone in Dubai, attested documents and payment of fees. See Dubai Municipality approvals.

Authority and inspection

US documents are normally notarised and then apostilled or authenticated by the state Secretary of State, or by the US Department of State for federal documents, before any further step needed for UAE use. The route depends on the document and on what the UAE side accepts, so we confirm it before you order anything. A power of attorney (POA drafting) lets our team receive the inspector and follow up on remarks, and the licence track is covered in company formation.

Home-country points that affect this service

  • Transfers from US banks to a Dubai company account are usually wires. Banks on both sides ask about the source of funds and the purpose, so keep invoices, agreements and share-capital papers ready.

Documents and information to prepare

  • The licence or initial approval and the activity description
  • A registered tenancy and a floor plan or layout
  • For food activities: a food safety plan and equipment details
  • Passport copies for the owner and authorised signatory
  • A power of attorney signed in the United States, if the owner cannot attend

How it works from the United States

  1. We check whether your activity and premises need municipal approval.
  2. We prepare the file and book the review and inspection.
  3. Our team receives the inspector under your authority and follows up on remarks.
  4. The approval is added to the licence file and the renewal calendar.

Currency and payments

The dirham is pegged to the US dollar at 3.6725, so dollar payments convert at a stable rate. That removes exchange-rate risk on the dirham side for owners who budget and invoice in dollars.

faqs.answer: Setting up premises can affect where a company is managed and taxed. US citizens and residents are generally taxed on worldwide income wherever they live, and owners of foreign companies can have reporting duties such as FATCA-related forms, FBAR filings for foreign accounts and information returns for controlled foreign corporations. landings.contentHtml:
Mapping approvals for an investor from the United States

American founders and remote teams use Dubai as a base for clients in the Middle East, South Asia and Africa, and some move operations to work in a time zone that overlaps with Asia and Europe. Because the dirham is pegged to the dollar, contracts and budgets in dollars are easy to plan. Approvals depend on what you do and where, not on your passport, so we start with a short project brief and a map of authorities, documents and timing. See official government approvals and clearances.

Home-country duties alongside

US citizens and residents are generally taxed on worldwide income wherever they live, and owners of foreign companies can have reporting duties such as FATCA-related forms, FBAR filings for foreign accounts and information returns for controlled foreign corporations. There is no comprehensive US-UAE income tax treaty, so confirm your position with a US tax adviser before you form the company. Transfers from US banks to a Dubai company account are usually wires. Banks on both sides ask about the source of funds and the purpose, so keep invoices, agreements and share-capital papers ready. The licence track is in DED and DET services and municipal matters in Dubai Municipality approvals.

Home-country points that affect this service

  • US documents are normally notarised and then apostilled or authenticated by the state Secretary of State, or by the US Department of State for federal documents, before any further step needed for UAE use. The route depends on the document and on what the UAE side accepts, so we confirm it before you order anything.

Documents and information to prepare

  • A short brief: activity, premises, staff and start date
  • Passport copies and the licence or initial approval
  • Attested company documents from the United States for corporate owners
  • Layouts and technical details the authorities ask for
  • A list of existing approvals and their expiry dates

How it works from the United States

  1. We map the authorities and approvals for your activity.
  2. We prepare and submit each application in the right order.
  3. We follow inspections and queries.
  4. You receive one file with every approval and its expiry date.

Currency and payments

The dirham is pegged to the US dollar at 3.6725, so dollar payments convert at a stable rate. That removes exchange-rate risk on the dirham side for owners who budget and invoice in dollars.

landings.contentHtml:
Mapping approvals for an investor from South Africa

South African entrepreneurs and professionals use Dubai for trading, mining services, consulting and online businesses, and Dubai's time zone and flight links to Africa make it practical for Africa-focused companies. Approvals depend on what you do and where, not on your passport, so we start with a short project brief and a map of authorities, documents and timing. See official government approvals and clearances.

Home-country duties alongside

South African residents are generally taxed on worldwide income, and exchange control rules apply when residents invest or move capital abroad. South Africa and the UAE have a double tax agreement. Ask SARS or a South African tax adviser what applies to you. Residents who move capital offshore must follow exchange control rules and normally use an authorised dealer; limits apply. Keep your tax compliance records up to date before you transfer funds. The licence track is in DED and DET services and municipal matters in Dubai Municipality approvals.

Home-country points that affect this service

  • South African documents are apostilled by the Department of International Relations and Cooperation after notarisation or certification, and may need further steps for UAE use.

Documents and information to prepare

  • A short brief: activity, premises, staff and start date
  • Passport copies and the licence or initial approval
  • Attested company documents from South Africa for corporate owners
  • Layouts and technical details the authorities ask for
  • A list of existing approvals and their expiry dates

How it works from South Africa

  1. We map the authorities and approvals for your activity.
  2. We prepare and submit each application in the right order.
  3. We follow inspections and queries.
  4. You receive one file with every approval and its expiry date.

Currency and payments

The dirham is pegged to the US dollar, so the rand-dirham rate follows the rand-dollar market, which can be volatile. Plan costs with a margin for exchange-rate movement.

  • Company Formation for South African clients: read the South Africa guide
  • Trade License Renewal & Amendments for South African clients: read the South Africa guide
  • Government Transactions Liaison for South African clients: read the South Africa guide

See also the full guide to setting up in Dubai from South Africa.

Costs and timings on this page are indicative and were last reviewed in November 2026. Authorities change fees, forms and processing times, so we confirm the current figure in writing before any work starts.

Tell us where you are based and what you need, and contact our team. We will confirm the steps, documents and fees in writing before any work starts.
